answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 293 Country: Pakistan Title: I struggle with urine dribbling and gas issues, making it hard to maintain wudu for salah—can I pray with one wudu, and what should I do about the urine problem? Question: I have great difficulty in offering salah because I have two problems; one of dripling of urine especially after urinating or doing wudu and second of passage of gas, I cannot concentertate on my prayer because all the time I try to control my urine drops from coming out and gas sometime I even fell pain in back because I think it is affecting my kidneys. I went to Jamia Ashrafia and they told me that u can offer salah with one wudu and not do wudu again and again but I did not ask them about urine problem kindly let me know cause I have to don wudu again and again its and it takes me almost 10 minutes to complete wudu and after 1 or 2 rakats it again breaks kindly let me know especially about urine problem cause it affectin my brain. Answer ID: 293 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 428/J) If the urine keeps on dripping and gas keeps on passing, and you do not find a time free from these problems in which you can perform wuzu and salah , then you are a mazoor . It is allowed for you to perform wuzu when prayer time enters and perform as many salah as you wish. And, when the time of second salah enters make another wuzu . You do not need to control gas or urine by force, but it is better to change trouser before salah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
